title: Adding Custom Content to the Homepage Hero Section | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Adding Custom Content to the Homepage Hero Section Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000055030 To learn how to call a custom search module widget on a homepage as Custom Homepage Content, follow these steps: 1. Remove the search module or select the option to add a Hero Message with button Links: - To remove the search module navigate to the Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Tab >> Search Box / Call to Action : On Homepage Search Box Call to Action, select the Call to Action as " Hide Search Module / Call to Action ": - To learn how to add the Hero Message with links, refer to this article Hero Message with Links - Up to Three Buttons on Homepage This example shows what a homepage looks like when using the Display Buttons Links option: 2. Call the preferred search filter widget on the homepage. - Search the preferred widget by navigating to Toolbox - Widget Manager and copy its short code for future usage: - Navigate to My Content >> Web Page Builder >> Click "Edit" on Homepage : - Paste the shortcode copied earlier to the Page Content and Save: 3. Add the custom search module to the Homepage: -Navigate to Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Tab >> Enable Additional Sections >> Select Content to Display - In Select Content to Display, select Custom Homepage Content on a preferred Section: This is an example of what the homepage looks like with the custom search widget and the links: How to Add Custom Content Above or Below the Hero Section: We created these two empty widgets into the homepage hero code: Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Extra Content Above Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Extra Content Below These widgets allow users to easily add content directly above and below homepage search modules without customizing other important widgets: Once the custom content is saved into the widget: The content will display in the corresponding placements in the hero section: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
